prompt: The workspace evals/out/04-org-policy-application/ws/ holds intent.md and PROJECT-POLICY.md. The project owner authorizes producing a spec from this draft intent for this evaluation; record that exception, leave approval to the owner. Read CLAUDE.md, .claude/skills/design-spec/SKILL.md and templates/spec.md. Apply the loaded intent-sdlc-skills:spec-policy-pass skill with design-spec. Enumerate the actual local and plugin skills, open every applicable skill body before citing it, and write spec.md in this workspace in Korean. Apply at least the available brand, data-compliance, secure-api-review and ux-copy skills to the concrete requirements; do not just list their names. In spec.md, quote a short relevant clause excerpt from each of those four skills, retain the clause ID or heading (ux-copy has headings), and explain its concrete design consequence or conflict. For data-compliance cover both sensitive-data handling and the access-trail requirements. Record actual skill source and verified version; report version-unverified when tools or metadata cannot establish it. Use the workspace's PROJECT-POLICY.md, not another project's values. Do not invent policy values or approve a conflict. In this non-interactive run, name the responsible owner in Flagged concerns for decisions that require a person. Create no plan or code.
expected_output: spec.md applies brand B3 to the timestamp display; data-compliance C2 to employee fields and logs plus C3 to the trail and retention conflict; secure-api-review authentication to the endpoint; ux-copy Error Messages to a usable error. The spec quotes relevant policy content, names a policy owner for the unresolved deletion conflict, and records skill sources and verified versions. Names alone fail the deterministic checks; semantic correctness still requires review of the assertions.
measures: Whether the explicitly loaded repository plugin contributes concrete policy clauses to a spec. Existing string checks detect missing clause evidence; they do not establish that the model read a skill or correctly resolved the design.
assertions: The tool trace actually reads the applied local and loaded-plugin skill bodies before naming them, and sources and versions describe those exact files
The timestamp design follows B3; employee_email and employee_phone are excluded from logs and unnecessary response fields under C2
C3's access-trail design records actor, business entity and UTC time, and the immediate deletion request is flagged against P2's 90-day retention without silently approving it
The new endpoint requires gateway JWT authentication and the error copy explains the failed operation, known cause and next action
All available skills have an applicability decision and reason; the spec invents neither source versions nor project policy values

checks.value: What happened + Why + How to fix
